reference_method.implementation: CPython standard library csv and Decimal at 50 digits plus an independent C++17 header-mapped semantic probe
reference_method.derivation: Solve constant vertical acceleration analytically at each declared t_k, map Legacy columns to fixture-local semantic field ids, and compare two captured datasets without relying on column position.

legacy_observation.source_assertion: The frozen test requires header plus t0, t1 and t2 rows and checks altitude and vertical velocity by header name.
legacy_observation.implementation_fact: Simulator publishes each t_k before discrete work and recording; AutoDataLogger records t0 when record_initial_state is enabled and CsvRecordSink encodes the selected fields.

encoding_equivalence.unmapped_columns: ignored after required semantic fields are mapped
encoding_equivalence.numeric_text_format: finite Decimal-equivalent forms accepted after parsing
encoding_equivalence.duplicate_unmapped_header: accepted after required semantic fields are mapped

equivalence_cases.mutation: Reverse all encoded CSV columns while retaining their headers and values
Re-encode required finite numeric values with Decimal-equivalent exponent notation
Replace every unmapped column value with unrelated opaque text
Add a second unmapped column with the same header and unrelated opaque values

failure_cases.mutation: Remove the initial sample while record_initial_state is true
Change the second row time from 0.5 to 0.75
Keep t1 altitude at the t0 published value 1000
Replace each required numeric field in turn with NaN, Infinity or -Infinity
Remove each required semantic column in turn while keeping row widths consistent
Encode the required altitude column twice

facts.target_mapping: Each semantic observation row identifies its declared t_k sample boundary
Truth fields are projected from the state published at the row's t_k boundary
Legacy column order, concatenated header names, numeric text format, session filename and output directory
